$comment: Programme issues for the beans that apply to the workstreams (beans analysis, 2026-10-20). Created by scripts/programme/create-items.ts; the beans themselves are not changed (owner: nothing that touches other repositories). A bean whose file URL is longer than 140 characters is named and linked by its folder: a longer URL does not survive being written from an agent session.

items.title: Epic proposal (WS1): WHO guidance into the L1 knowledge graph
items.body:
Ingest WHO guidance and the evidence behind it into the L1 knowledge graph: one ingestion pipeline from source documents to a complete library, extraction of guideline tables and recommendations into knowledge-graph nodes, the bibliography, and terminology checked against existing vocabularies. The immunizations L1 graph is the first instance.

This is an **epic proposal** (req:aai-linking#LINK-07): the PM & Architecture Integration accepts, amends or declines it. Once accepted it takes the `type:epic` label and appears in V1. Its features below are sub-issues.

items.title: Epic proposal (WS2): L1 and DAK authoring on the SMART stack
items.body:
Author L2 operational content (the DAK) and the L1 document it comes from as document kinds, with their processes (BPMN), personas, data dictionary and process catalogues, and support for reviewing large documents. Builds on the SMART stack (core, FHIR harness, smart-base).

This is an **epic proposal** (req:aai-linking#LINK-07): the PM & Architecture Integration accepts, amends or declines it. Once accepted it takes the `type:epic` label and appears in V1. Its features below are sub-issues.

items.title: Epic proposal (WS3): evaluate outputs across models and routes
items.body:
Evaluate what the pipeline produces: outcome evaluation of runs across models, test data for subject-matter-expert review of decision support and indicators, fixed and generated data sets, and controlled experiments on how a run is managed. Feeds the comparison of Route 0, Route A and Route B with the Control route.

This is an **epic proposal** (req:aai-linking#LINK-07): the PM & Architecture Integration accepts, amends or declines it. Once accepted it takes the `type:epic` label and appears in V1. Its features below are sub-issues.

items.title: Epic proposal (WS4): translated renders and their review
items.body:
Translate published renders and review the translations: the translation pipeline, authoring the translation catalogues, and adjudicating round-trip findings. Country adaptation of a DAK is not yet covered by any work item.

This is an **epic proposal** (req:aai-linking#LINK-07): the PM & Architecture Integration accepts, amends or declines it. Once accepted it takes the `type:epic` label and appears in V1. Its features below are sub-issues.

items.title: Epic proposal (Platform): deployment, publishing and the knowledge graph's publication
items.body:
Shared hosting and engineering: deployment topologies, agent-run publishing of the SMART IG repositories, tool contracts and releases for the health-skill (MCP) surface, and publishing the knowledge graph with a complete JSON-LD context.

This is an **epic proposal** (req:aai-linking#LINK-07): the PM & Architecture Integration accepts, amends or declines it. Once accepted it takes the `type:epic` label and appears in V1. Its features below are sub-issues.

items.title: D-B1: Fetching IRIS PDFs and FHIR packages that the agents' environment cannot reach
items.body:
- Waiting workstream: WS1 Knowledge graph (also WS2 and Platform)
- Waiting epic: the WS1 epic proposal
- Depends on workstream: Platform
- Depends on: a way for agents to fetch WHO IRIS documents and FHIR packages their environment blocks
- Needed by: before the L1 ingestion of new guidance
- Consequence if late: no new L1 sources; IG builds that need FHIR packages cannot run
- Next action: Platform decides how agents get network access to these hosts; the Platform lead, once named
- Owner: the PM & Architecture Integration

From bean(s) folio-assistant-53rv ([its folder](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant/tree/cat/cat-harness/beans/beans/defs)). The D-number is a placeholder until the PM numbers it.
